--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/reusebench_pytest_async/steps.py
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+"""Prepare records for the asynchronous-function display pipeline."""
+
+from _pytest.compat import is_async_function
+
+
+def prepare(record: object) -> dict:
+    """Validate a record and return a normalized copy with its display value."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not (key := key.strip()):
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must contain a value")
+
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {
+        "key": key,
+        "value": value,
+        "display": callable(value) and bool(is_async_function(value)),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }

diff --git a/src/reusebench_pytest_async/steps.py b/src/reusebench_pytest_async/steps.py
index 4350edc..01cef36 100644
--- a/src/reusebench_pytest_async/steps.py
+++ b/src/reusebench_pytest_async/steps.py
@@ -25,3 +25,20 @@ def prepare(record: object) -> dict:
         "display": callable(value) and bool(is_async_function(value)),
         "enabled": enabled,
     }
+
+
+def batch(records: object) -> list[dict]:
+    """Prepare a list in order, rejecting duplicate normalized keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+
+    prepared = []
+    keys = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in keys:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate record key: {key!r}")
+        keys.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

@@ -42,3 +42,12 @@ def batch(records: object) -> list[dict]:
         keys.add(key)
         prepared.append(item)
     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records: object) -> dict[str, list[bool]]:
+    """Group enabled display values by the first character of their keys."""
+    grouped: dict[str, list[bool]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            grouped.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return grouped

+
+def merge(left: object, right: object) -> list[dict]:
+    """Merge prepared records by key, keeping the first position of each key."""
+    by_key = {item["key"]: item for item in batch(left)}
+    by_key.update((item["key"], item) for item in batch(right))
+    return list(by_key.values())
